Findings from auditing the diff against spec-1-2, epic-1-context, prototype-extract, and the architecture spine. All claims below were independently verified by running `dart format`, `fvm flutter analyze`, and `fvm flutter test` against the actual working tree.

- **New test file is not formatter-clean, repeating the exact defect the spec claims was already patched** — Violates the spec's own Verification bar (and the already-closed "[Review][Patch] Run `dart format` on the three new widget files" finding at spec-1-2…md:75). Evidence: `fvm dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed test/core/widgets/component_library_interaction_test.dart` reports `Changed … (1 changed)` — i.e. fails. The three widget files (`app_button.dart`, `app_text_field.dart`, `avatar.dart`) are correctly formatter-clean per the diff's reformatting, but the diff's own new file, `test/core/widgets/component_library_interaction_test.dart`, is not (multiple long `testWidgets(...)` calls and `enterText`/`pumpWidget` calls exceed line length and aren't wrapped the way `dart format` would wrap them).

- **`test-summary.md`'s reported test count is factually wrong** — Violates the "Running and verifying" / `fvm flutter test` verification convention (AGENTS.md) and the spec's own Verification section, which require accurate, checkable results. Evidence: the diff states `fvm flutter test` — 131/131 passing (124 pre-existing + 7 new)` (test-summary.md, new "Verification" section). Running `fvm flutter test` on the actual working tree reports `+168` with `All tests passed!` — i.e. 161 pre-existing + 7 new = 168, not 131. The number silently excludes the already-merged Story 1.3 auth test suites (`auth_cubit_test.dart`, `auth_screen_test.dart`, `auth_repository_impl_test.dart`, `auth_validators_test.dart`, plus the Story 1.3 bootstrap-integration addition), which already exist on `main` at commit `8a4b944` beneath this diff.

- **The new interaction test's entire justification is built on a false "no real screen exists yet" premise, and it duplicates coverage of the real screen it pretends doesn't exist** — Deviates from spec intent (the "Suggested Review Order"/"Design Notes" sections frame Story 1.2 as upstream-only tokens/primitives, consumed by Story 1.3's screen, not re-testing a future screen's shape) and from the diff's own stated rationale. Evidence: test-summary.md's new "Context" section says *"no screen or navigation exists yet (story 1.3 owns the first real screen)"* and frames the harness as covering gaps *"a story ahead of when that screen actually exists."* This is false at the time of the diff: `lib/features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart` already exists (committed in `8a4b944`, "story 1.3 — account creation & login", which is *parent* of this diff per `git status`), already composes `AppTextField`/`AppTextField`/`AppButton` exactly as described (confirmed via grep on `auth_screen.dart` lines 127/136/146/153-154), and already has a 294-line `auth_screen_test.dart` covering nearly the same scenarios the new synthetic `_LoginShapedForm` reinvents (disabled-submit-until-both-fields-filled, invalid-email error border/text, Dynamic-Type-scale overflow check). The new test exercises a fabricated stand-in widget instead of the real, already-shipped composition it claims doesn't exist yet, undermining the stated purpose ("nothing proved the components work together the way a real screen will compose them") since that proof already existed via the real screen's own test suite.

- **Spec Change Log not updated for this round of patches, breaking the established documentation convention** — Minor inconsistency with the spec's own precedent ("Spec Change Log" section documents "Review round 1" with an itemized list of what was patched/rejected). Evidence: the diff adds a new "### Review Findings" checklist (spec-1-2…md:72-78) and makes corresponding code patches (removing `disabledBorder`, running `dart format`), but does not add a "Review round 2" entry to the existing "Spec Change Log" section the way round 1 was documented — leaving two parallel, inconsistently-maintained change-tracking mechanisms in the same file.

No violations found regarding: RNF08 token literals (repo-wide grep for `Color(0x|fontSize:|EdgeInsets.(all|symmetric|only)(` outside `design_tokens.dart` returns zero matches — confirmed clean), the disabled-button/text-field-error-border/Dynamic-Type acceptance criteria (all still correctly implemented in `app_button.dart`/`app_text_field.dart`/`avatar.dart`), the frozen Intent/Boundaries/Constraints section of the spec (untouched by this diff), and `fvm flutter analyze` (reports "No issues found!").
